intro.say: A useful AI workflow needs more than an answer. It needs coordination, and work you can check.

request.say: Here is a real Atoma project: a personal reading log. Add books, filter by status, and keep your data when you return.

coordination.say: Three tiers work together. A planner breaks down the goal. Supervisors delegate and review. Workers use tools. Missing evidence sends work back for correction.

reject.say: In this production run, the first final review refused the delivery. Adding books worked, but filtering had not been demonstrated. Passing some tests was not enough.

approve.say: Atoma continued the work. The next review confirmed all four criteria: responsive layout, working interactions, six passing tests, and clear documentation.

app.say: These are the actual delivered files, opened locally. Select Reading: only the matching book remains. Reload, and both saved books are still there.

control.say: Follow the decisions, inspect the files, and review the evidence. Atoma's checks are separate from your acceptance. You stay in control of what happens next.

close.say: From a request to checked work. Atoma.
